component.name: Footprint
component.summary: Black top bar, round window buttons, a dock on the left

description.p: A dark style for the FlickOS desktop: a black top bar, grey windows with the title in the middle and round buttons, a dark grey terminal and a dusk wallpaper.

It comes with its own layout: the top bar shows your desktops as dots on the left and the clock in the middle, and a dock on the left edge holds your apps and Show Apps, which opens the full-screen apps menu. Use sets both; you can still pick another layout in Settings.
